name: cr-reminder
title: Code Review Reminder
description: Reminds developers about GitHub Pull Requests waiting for review and posts a compact, tagged message to Slack.

input.title: Input
input.description: Configure GitHub source (org + topic), Slack Bot destination, working-time thresholds and mode.

githubToken.title: GitHub Token
githubToken.description: Personal access token with repo read scope (classic: 'repo'; fine-grained: 'Pull requests: Read', 'Issues: Read', 'Metadata: Read').

githubOrg.title: GitHub Organization
githubOrg.description: GitHub organization whose repositories should be scanned (e.g., 'apify-store').

githubTopic.title: GitHub Topic
githubTopic.description: Only repositories in the org that carry this topic are scanned (e.g., 'apify-actor').

slackBotToken.title: Slack Bot Token
slackBotToken.description: Slack Bot User OAuth Token (xoxb-...). See SLACK_SETUP.md for step-by-step instructions.

slackChannelId.title: Slack Channel ID
slackChannelId.description: Destination channel ID (e.g., C01234567). Right-click channel → 'Copy channel ID'.

userMapping.title: User mapping overrides
userMapping.description: Optional overrides layered on top of the mapping file — handy to fix or add one person without redeploying. Example: { "radimkvet": "U123ABC456" }

mode.title: Mode
mode.description: 'overdue' lists only PRs past overdueThresholdHours or iterationOverdueThresholdHours; 'all' lists every eligible open PR.

sendEmptyReport.title: Send Empty Report
sendEmptyReport.description: If true, post 'no open PRs' message when nothing is overdue. If false, skip Slack entirely.

ignoreLabels.title: Ignore Labels
ignoreLabels.description: PRs (or their linked issues) carrying any of these labels are skipped. Labels are case-sensitive, matching GitHub.

overdueThresholdHours.title: Overdue Threshold (hours)
overdueThresholdHours.description: In 'overdue' mode, a PR is reported once it has been waiting this many hours. The team baseline is 24 — somebody should have looked at every PR within a day of it becoming ready.

warningThresholdHours.title: Warning Threshold (hours)
warningThresholdHours.description: PRs waiting >= this many hours get :warning:. Must be <= screamThresholdHours.
warningThresholdHours.sectionDescription: Controls the emoji shown next to each PR. warning <= scream.

screamThresholdHours.title: Scream Threshold (hours)
screamThresholdHours.description: PRs waiting >= this many hours get :scream:.

iterationOverdueThresholdHours.title: Iteration Overdue Threshold (hours)
iterationOverdueThresholdHours.description: In 'overdue' mode a PR is reported when it breaches EITHER the total-age threshold OR this one, measured from the start of the current review round.
iterationOverdueThresholdHours.sectionDescription: A new round starts when a review is re-requested. These limits measure how long reviewers have been sitting on the current state, independent of the total PR age.

iterationWarningThresholdHours.title: Iteration Warning Threshold (hours)
iterationWarningThresholdHours.description: Current round waiting >= this many hours gets :warning:. Must be <= iterationScreamThresholdHours.

iterationScreamThresholdHours.title: Iteration Scream Threshold (hours)
iterationScreamThresholdHours.description: Current round waiting >= this many hours gets :scream:.

skipWeekends.title: Skip weekends
skipWeekends.description: Exclude Saturdays and Sundays from every waiting time. A PR that goes ready on Friday afternoon is then still fresh on Monday morning.
skipWeekends.sectionDescription: Weekends are dead time for reviews; counting them makes every Monday look like a crisis.

timeZone.title: Time zone
timeZone.description: IANA time zone deciding where the weekend boundaries fall (for example "Europe/Prague"). Only used when skipWeekends is on.

requireLinkedIssue.title: Only report PRs linked to an issue
requireLinkedIssue.description: When on, a PR whose description does not close an issue (for example "Fixes #123") is skipped entirely. Off by default: every PR in review is reported.

userMappingFile.title: User mapping file
userMappingFile.description: Path (relative to the actor root) of the JSON file holding the GitHub login -> Slack user ID table. Keeping the table in a file means a growing team does not bloat the run input.

newPrHeaderText.title: New PR section header
newPrHeaderText.default: New PRs — nobody has looked at these yet:
newPrHeaderText.description: Heading for the separate block listing PRs that nobody has reviewed yet. The block is omitted when there are none.
